verses: To the chief Musician, of David, for invocation.
Make haste, O God, to deliver me; to help me, O Lord.
Let them be ashamed and confounded who seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, who desire my hurt.
Let them be turned back because of their shame who say, Aha, aha.
Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: and let such as love Thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O Lord.
